{{Quote|Beyond Tython, they settled first on Kalimahr, jewel of the Tython system, then Shikaakwa, the outlaw world, then on the forest planet Ska Gora, and on the moons of the Giants&mdash;Obri and Mawr&mdash;and even the outermost planet, cold Furies Gate.|[[Ketu]], of the non&ndash;Force-sensitive Tythans|<ref name="DotJ1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Kalimahr''' was a cosmopolitan [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region. More than thirty-six thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], it was the first [[Planet/Legends|planet]] the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] colonized. By [[25,793 BBY]], Kalimahr had become a business and religious center of the [[Star system/Legends|system]], boasting a high-density, well-integrated population and [[City/Legends|cities]] built out of white metal, along with tall spires. Kalimahr was referred to as the "jewel of the Tython system" by that [[Time/Legends|time]].

==Description==
[[File:Spires_of_Kalimahr.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The spires of Kalimahr]]
{{Expandsect}}
Kalimahr was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] region,<ref name="DotJ0" /> at grid coordinates L-10.<ref name="EAOC" /> The planet occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|sun]], [[Tythos]]. From [[Realspace/Legends|space]], Kalimahr appeared to be green in [[Color/Legends|color]]. The planet featured an [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] with white-colored clouds, and it also had at least one [[Mountain/Legends|mountainous]] region on its surface. Several [[City/Legends|cities]] that were considered to beautiful were built on Kalimahr out of white metal, with tall spires gracing the cities. At least four such spires stood on a green-colored foothill of the mountains of Kalimahr's surface.<ref name="DotJ0" />

It contained at least one body of water, known as the [[Southern Ocean]] which mostly occupied the southern hemisphere of the planet. The city of [[Rhol Yan]] and the [[Khar Peninsula]] lay on opposite sides of this body of water. It also contained the island of [[Hang Layden]].
The [[Kalimahr militia]] was responsible for keeping order. They were posted in [[Kalimahr militia post]]s commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captains]]. A lower rank was [[Constable/Legends|Constable]]--[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorus]] would remark that he had been a constable and "still in training" during an incident with [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Vulk]].
Rhol Yan was a [[City/Legends|city]] and a major tourist attraction built on an archipelago in the [[Southern Ocean]]. It was governed by a [[Council of Rhol Yan|Council]] and policed by the Kalimahr militia. It required all of its visitors from space to pass through [[Welcome Hall]].

While generally considered a very civilized planet, [[Rhol Yan]] contained [[The Pits (arena)|The Pits]]--a brutal gladiatorial arena. The Council of Rhol Yan tolerated such establishments as they channeled aggression. However [[Tre Sana]] and [[Lanoree Brock]] would be disgusted by them.<ref name="Void" />

==History==
More than a [[Time/Legends|millennium]] after<ref name="DotJ1" /> the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[36,453 BBY]],<ref name="Void" /> when the non&ndash;[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Tythan|settlers]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ1" /> the fifth planet of the Tython [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;<ref name="DotJ0" /> [[Second migration|traveled]] to Tython's neighboring worlds, Kalimahr was the first planet they colonized.<ref name="DotJ1" /> By [[25,793 BBY]],<ref name="Void" /> it had become a cosmopolitan world, serving as the business and religious hub of the system. Kalimahr was one of the most densely populated of the [[Settled Worlds|colonized planets]] in the Tython system, and its population was very integrated. By that time, Kalimahr had come to be known as the "jewel of the Tython system"<ref name="DotJ0" /> and the most diverse planet in that system, containing many different religions including the [[Order of Dai Bendu|Dai Bendu]] and [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] belief systems.<ref name="Void" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalimahr was first pictured in the entry for Tython in [[The Holonet]] feature of the official website for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''&mdash;a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[BioWare]]. The planet was depicted in a schematic of the Tython system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic.<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|planets|tython|Tython}}</ref> Kalimahr's name and additional information on it were provided in ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0]]'', a preview issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi]]'' series of [[Star Wars comic books|comic books]]. The issue was published on [[February 1]], [[2012]], and was written by [[John Ostrander]] and penciled by [[Jan Duursema]].<ref name="DotJ0" /> The world was also mentioned in the [[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|first]] issue of the series, which was published on [[February 15]] of the same year.<ref name="DotJ1" /> Kalimahr briefly appeared in [[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 3|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 3]],<ref name="DotJ7" /> and more importantly in ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''.<ref name="Void" />
